top_signals.title: Key Russian Baltic Port on Fire After Overnight Drone Strikes
top_signals.summary: An overnight drone strike sparked a fire at the Baltic port of Ust-Luga, the latest attack in Ukraine’s intensifying campaign against Russian energy infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Poland pivots to homegrown defense production as it builds Europe’s biggest army
top_signals.summary: The Ukraine conflict is a top priority for Poland as the country shares a border with Ukraine and sees Russia as an existential threat, officials said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jollibee Picks Hong Kong Over US for International Unit Listing
top_signals.summary: Philippine fast-food giant Jollibee Foods Corp. is pivoting to a Hong Kong listing for its international unit, abandoning an earlier plan to sell shares in the US.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
